en.name: English
en.title: mySSH — open-source SSH client for macOS, Linux and Windows
en.description: Free, open-source SSH client for macOS, Linux and Windows, written in Rust: profiles, tabs, split panes, SFTP, folder sync and AWS SSM Session Manager, secrets in the system vault.
en.tagline: The SSH session manager that keeps your secrets where they belong.
en.lead: Profiles, tabs, split panes, SFTP, folder sync and AWS EC2 access through SSM Session Manager in one fast native app written in Rust. Passwords go to the system vault, host keys are checked strictly, and there is no telemetry.
en.f1_d: Folders, tags, favorites and DEV / STAGING / PRODUCTION environments with a warning stripe. Quick connect without saving anything.
en.f2_d: Password, private key with or without passphrase, SSH agent, keyboard-interactive / MFA and EC2 Instance Connect temporary keys, through jump hosts.
en.f3_d: Secrets in Keychain, Credential Manager or Secret Service, never in plain text. Strict host keys: a changed key blocks the connection before anything is sent.
en.f4_d: Reach instances with no public IP or open port 22 through Session Manager, without the AWS CLI. AWS profiles or in-app IAM Identity Center sign-in.
en.f5_d: A native terminal (alacritty_terminal) with per-profile themes, six palettes and confirmation for multi-line paste.
en.f6_d: Local and remote side by side, transfer queue, conflict handling, cancellation and resume of large files.
en.f7_d: One-way sync that shows every change before it runs. Deletions are off by default and mirror mode is protected.
en.f8_d: No telemetry and no update checks: the only network traffic is the connections you start. Interface in English, Portuguese and Spanish.
en.screens_note: Screenshots use fictitious data from a local test server.
en.download_lead: Pre-built packages for the latest version. They are not signed yet, so your system will warn you the first time.
en.no_binary: No package for this version yet. Build it from source (below).
en.note_mac: Unsigned app: on first launch, right-click it and choose Open.
en.source_lead: mySSH is free software, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0. Download the source of this version or clone the repository.
en.build_lead: Requires stable Rust (2024 edition). On Debian/Ubuntu, install the window and GPU libraries first with make deps-linux.
en.a1: mySSH is a free, open-source desktop SSH client and session manager for macOS, Linux and Windows, written in Rust. It combines saved connection profiles, a tabbed terminal with split panes, an SFTP file panel and one-way folder sync in a single native app.
en.a2: Yes. mySSH is free software, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0. There is no paid edition, no account and no subscription.
en.q3: Where does mySSH store passwords and passphrases?
en.a3: In the operating system's credential vault: Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows and Secret Service on Linux. Secrets are never written in plain text to disk, logs or process arguments.
en.q4: Does mySSH support jump hosts, SSH agents and MFA?
en.a4: Yes. It logs in with a password, a private key (with or without passphrase), the SSH agent or keyboard-interactive authentication, including one-time MFA codes, also through jump hosts (bastions).
en.a5: No. There is no telemetry, no account and no automatic update check. The only network connections are the SSH and SFTP sessions you open.
en.q6: Is mySSH an alternative to PuTTY or Termius?
en.a6: Yes. mySSH covers the same everyday work, terminal sessions, saved hosts and file transfer, as a native open-source app that keeps all data on your computer, with no cloud service involved.
en.q7: Can mySSH connect to AWS EC2 instances through SSM Session Manager?
en.a7: Yes. mySSH opens the Session Manager tunnel itself, without the AWS CLI or the session-manager-plugin, so the instance needs no public IP or open port 22. Credentials come from your AWS profiles (~/.aws) or from IAM Identity Center sign-in inside the app, and with EC2 Instance Connect a temporary key is generated on each connection, so nothing has to be set up on the server.

pt-br.a1: O mySSH é um cliente SSH e gerenciador de sessões para desktop, gratuito e de código aberto, para macOS, Linux e Windows, escrito em Rust. Ele reúne perfis de conexão salvos, terminal com abas e painéis divididos, painel de arquivos SFTP e sincronização unidirecional de pastas em um único app nativo.
pt-br.a2: Sim. O mySSH é software livre, com licença dupla MIT ou Apache-2.0. Não há edição paga, conta nem assinatura.
pt-br.q3: Onde o mySSH guarda senhas e passphrases?
pt-br.a3: No cofre de credenciais do sistema operacional: Keychain no macOS, Credential Manager no Windows e Secret Service no Linux. Segredos nunca são gravados em texto puro no disco, em logs ou em argumentos de processo.
pt-br.q4: O mySSH suporta jump hosts, agente SSH e MFA?
pt-br.a4: Sim. Ele autentica por senha, chave privada (com ou sem passphrase), agente SSH ou keyboard-interactive, inclusive códigos MFA de uso único, também através de jump hosts (bastions).
pt-br.a5: Não. Não há telemetria, conta nem verificação automática de atualização. As únicas conexões de rede são as sessões SSH e SFTP que você abre.

pt-br.a6: Sim. O mySSH cobre o mesmo trabalho do dia a dia, sessões de terminal, hosts salvos e transferência de arquivos, como um app nativo de código aberto que mantém todos os dados no seu computador, sem serviço em nuvem.
pt-br.q7: O mySSH conecta em instâncias AWS EC2 pelo SSM Session Manager?
pt-br.a7: Sim. O mySSH abre o túnel do Session Manager sozinho, sem o AWS CLI nem o session-manager-plugin, então a instância não precisa de IP público nem de porta 22 aberta. As credenciais vêm dos seus perfis AWS (~/.aws) ou do login no IAM Identity Center dentro do app, e com o EC2 Instance Connect uma chave temporária é gerada a cada conexão: nada precisa ser configurado no servidor.

Reúne perfiles de conexión guardados, un terminal con pestañas y paneles divididos, un panel de archivos SFTP y sincronización unidireccional de carpetas en una sola app nativa.
